newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Lawyers contest Brazil's privatization program.
newsitem.headline: Lawyers contest Brazil's privatization program.

text.p: The Order of Brazilian Lawyers (OAB) lodged an appeal with the Supreme Frederal Tribunal (STF) Tuesday for the suspension of future privatizations, an STF spokesman said.
The spokesman said the OAB was contesting the constitutionality of a 1990 law setting up Brazil's national privatization program.
The action could affect the April 29 start of mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce's (CVRD) sell-off.
In a statement, the lawyers' group said it would demonstrate outside the court this afternoon against the privatization of CVRD.
The suit is not the first action taken against the CVRD sale.
The government has until April 23 to provide information to the high court so it can rule on another plea for an injunction against the sell-off lodged by two lawyers from Minas Gerais state.
